title: Fifty Is Half of a Hundred

steps.prompt: Stickers cost $50$ cents each. How much do $14$ stickers cost? Is there a quick way?

cards.title: Use a hundred, then halve
cards.body: Multiplying by $100$ is easy: the digits move two places left. $50$ is half of $100$, so times $50$ is times $100$, halved. $14 \times 50$: $14 \times 100 = 1400$, half is $700$.

steps.text: Halve the $18$ first: half of $18$ is $9$.
So $18 \times 50 = 900$. Halve-then-times-$100$ is quick when the number is even.

cards.title: Odd numbers
cards.body: For an odd number like $7 \times 50$: $7 \times 100 = 700$, and half of $700$ is $350$. Halving last always works.

prompts: Why is $\times 50$ the same as $\times 100$ and then halving?
